Acts by binding to and activating the insulin receptor INSR, a receptor tyrosine kinase, triggering INSR autophosphorylation and recruitment/phosphorylation of insulin receptor substrate proteins IRS1 and IRS2, which activate the downstream PI3K/AKT and RAS/MAPK signaling cascades (PubMed:7983060). Through the PI3K/AKT pathway, stimulates glucose uptake into skeletal muscle and adipose tissue by promoting translocation of the glucose transporter GLUT4/SLC2A4 from intracellular storage vesicles to the plasma membrane (PubMed:9235985). In liver and muscle, promotes glycogen synthesis through AKT-mediated inhibitory phosphorylation of glycogen synthase kinase-3 (GSK3), thereby activating glycogen synthase (PubMed:7763247). In the liver, suppresses hepatic glucose production by inhibiting gluconeogenesis, in part through phosphorylation and exclusion of the FOXO1 transcription factor, which downregulates the gluconeogenic enzymes PEPCK and glucose-6-phosphatase (PubMed:12754525). In adipose tissue, promotes lipogenesis and potently suppresses lipolysis, reducing the flux of free fatty acids and glycerol to the liver and thereby further restraining hepatic gluconeogenesis (PubMed:15113941)"}],"commentType":"FUNCTION"},{"commentType":"SUBCELLULAR LOCATION","subcellularLocations":[{"location":{"evidences":[{"evidenceCode":"ECO:0000269","source":"PubMed","id":"36309486"}],"value":"Secreted","id":"SL-0243"}}]}],"sequence":{"value":"MALWMRLLPLLALLALWGPDPAAAFVNQHLCGSHLVEALYLVCGERGFFYTPKTRREAEDLQVGQVELGGGPGAGSLQPLALEGSLQKRGIVEQCCTSICSLYQLENYCN","length":110,"molWeight":11981,"crc64":"C2C3B23B85E520E5","md5":"12E9C9E4E2835C302E8BA615115EDDA3"},"extraAttributes":{"uniParcId":"UPI00000017EA"}}
